semantictasks-desc: Sends email notifications for assigned or updated tasks
semantictasks-newtask-body-1: The task "$1" has just been created.
semantictasks-taskupdated-body-1: The task "$1" has just been updated.
semantictasks-taskclosed-body-1: The task "$1" has just been closed.
semantictasks-taskunassigned-body-1: You have just been unassigned from the task "$1".
semantictasks-talkpageoftaskcreated-subj: Talk page of task article has been created
semantictasks-talkpageoftaskcreated-body: Talk page related to task article "$1" has been created
semantictasks-talkpageoftaskedited-subje: Talk page of task article has been edited
semantictasks-talkpageoftaskedited-body-: Talk page related to task article "$1" has been edited
semantictasks-taskdeleted-body-1: The article "$1" with assigned tasks has been deleted.
semantictasks-talkpageoftaskdeleted-subj: Talk page of article with assigned tasks deleted
semantictasks-talkpageoftaskdeleted-body: The talk page of the article "$1" with assigned tasks has been deleted.
semantictasks-taskassigned-body-1: The task "$1" has just been assigned to you.
semantictasks-reminder-body-1: Just to remind you that the task "$1" ends in $2 {{PLURAL:$2|day|days}}.
